content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm having trouble synchronizing date and time between [product_name] and Magelis HMIS5T. I know [product_name] has an RTC feature (VB985-VB990), but I’m unsure how to display this information on the HMIS5T. Magelis does not seem to support Bit functions for this purpose. Can anyone offer guidance? Thank you!
VB985 represents the year, VB986 the month, VB987 the day, VB988 the hours, VB989 the minutes, and VB990 the seconds. Each value is stored as a 16-bit integer.
I understand how these variables work, but with Vijeo Designer, it seems these variable types can't be directly used in the editor. Is there a way to add them to the variable editor?
Apologies, but that's only one byte (8 bits). I’m not familiar with the editor nor its capabilities. Can you set a different format aside from integer? Which formats can you choose?

Hello, I'm not certain this method will work reliably. If you have the most recent [product_name] and Vijeo Designer v4.5 or newer, you might try using Modbus for communication. [product_name] can provide date and time details to Modbus-compatible devices and HMIs using VM addresses 991 to 1002.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking to display real-time clock information from [product_name] on a Magelis HMIS5T HMI, but is facing compatibility issues with data types in Vijeo Designer. Various approaches were discussed, including using Modbus communication with specific [product_name] and Vijeo Designer versions, although some uncertainty remains regarding feasible solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a straightforward integration of real-time clock data from [product_name] to the HMIS5T, ideally with Vijeo Designer smoothly handling the data formats needed for visualization.
